new_this_week.title: The Hawk
new_this_week.about: Will Ferrell's first-ever TV comedy — a delusional washed-up golf legend Lonnie 'The Hawk' Hawkins chases one final major and drags everyone he loves into the chaos. Molly Shannon, Jimmy Tatro, Luke Wilson, Chris Parnell, Fortune Feimster support. PGA TOUR is a partner. All 10 eps drop 7/16.
new_this_week.why: 30-min ensemble comedy = bedtime slot. Ferrell/Shannon reunion + Chris Parnell = strong comic bench. Golf sub-genre is left-field for you, but it's really a workplace/family comedy in disguise.

new_this_week.title: Heartstopper Forever (Series Finale Film)
new_this_week.format: Feature film — the definitive series conclusion
new_this_week.about: The Heartstopper story ends as a 114-min film, replacing the planned S4. Nick heads to university; Charlie navigates a long-distance relationship in his final year. Alice Oseman writes and creates; Wash Westmore directs. Slightly grittier, more mature tone than the series.
new_this_week.why: LGBTQ+ inclusive + British + closure of a warm-hearted arc. Lower priority genre for you (sad-drama-adjacent), but it's a self-contained 1h54m and a definitive ending — no ongoing commitment.

new_this_week.why: 68% RT / 51% audience — considered the weakest of the trilogy, but a British mystery adventure with a strong lead if you want something breezy. Skip if it doesn't grab you in 20 min.
